geometry.provenance: bbox = pdftotext -bbox-layout on a born-digital page; estimated = the form's own fixed ruled-row pitch. A band is a POINTER to the row, never a value.

itemized.notes: wasatch_fcr_3line, cumulative regime; scanned. Aimee Armer, 'Wasatch County Council - At Large Seat B', Democrat, signed 6/23/2020, '7 Days preceding the Primary Election' checked. THREE schedule pages, not two: p2 Form A (in-kind only, with the filer's note '* see attached form for additional contribution'), p3 the attached FundHero contribution spreadsheet she labels Form A continued, p4 Form B. PRIVACY: p3 carries donor street addresses and MOBILE PHONE NUMBERS -- neither retained; only city/state recorded, and no city is inferred from a ZIP (Adler's row prints no state on the address line but the spreadsheet has an explicit State column). Expenditure rows carry no address fields, so the Form B address column (fundhero.io, SLC/Millcreek/Sandy/Vista addresses) is discarded at read time. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed on all three pages -- 26 dates/26 names/26 amounts on p4, 23/23/23 on p3, no date-shaped content in any name cell. The 'Name of Expenditure' column mixes payee and purpose ('Logo Design/Target Group', 'Website/101 Domain'); kept verbatim in vendor_raw with purpose left blank, as the sheet has no purpose column.

notes: CUMULATIVE column left blank; LAST REPORT printed 0 throughout.
